svg.title: Building Bathing-Water Supply Concept
svg.desc: Left: villa supply from geothermal well through water treatment, storage, circulation and water heating. Right: proposed fractured-well supply. Key: 别墅供应区 = villa supply area; 温泉水处理 = hot-spring treatment; 温泉储水箱 = storage tank; 温泉井 = geothermal well; 安全阀 = safety valve; 水加热器 = water heater; 循环水泵 = circulation pump; 温泉水入户 = supply to buildings; 自来水压降 = mains-water pressure drop; 高温缝隙 = high-temperature fractures; 封闭环 = sealing ring. Source claims abandoned-well revival and filing without mining rights; both require site/regulatory verification. Sealed heating does not create natural mineral water.
